sources.title: Operator wiki (private LLM wiki: business knowledge, research, internal decisions)

canonicalStore.location: SeaBridgeAI workspace folder (sibling of the repos): index.md, log.md, wiki/ pages; a local git repository with no remote

scope.notes: Karpathy LLM-wiki pattern. Raw sources (code, governed docs, dated reports, operator-provided material) stay the truth; each page cites them. Private because everything-claude-code is a public repository.

retention.policy: Kept in the workspace git history; log.md is append-only.
retention.supersession: A superseded page keeps its file with status: superseded and superseded_by.

citation.identifier: Workspace-relative page path; each page lists its sources

health.mechanism: vaultsafe validate (links, frontmatter) and the knowledge freshness check (sources newer than the page)
health.freshness: Page updated frontmatter compared with its cited sources

state.evidence: Workspace initialized as a local git repository with no remote (1a25b99 snapshot, 799b4f2 restructure): index.md, append-only log.md, wiki/maps (7 current maps with sources:, 2 superseded), wiki/decisions (4 dated records), rules in the workspace AGENTS.md (Wiki). vaultsafe validate PASS; knowledge-freshness wiki reports every page fresh except two maps whose cited registry is missing from the shared ECC checkout, which is behind origin.

The shared everything-claude-code checkout is behind origin, so pages citing new ECC files report a missing source there until it is updated.
